sec-head.eyebrow: Section eyebrow tag (e.g., 'What I offer'). Max 4 words.
sec-head.h2: Services heading (e.g., 'RAG development services I offer'). Max 7 words.

card.h3: Service name heading (e.g., 'RAG chatbot development'). Max 4-5 words.
card.p: Clear description of the service deliverables, technical scope, and safety boundaries. Exactly 1-2 sentences.

card cta-card.h3: CTA card headline (e.g., 'Not sure what you need?'). Max 5 words.
card cta-card.p: Actionable invitation to discuss or preview specs (e.g., 'Try the spec-preview widget above, or get it scoped properly.'). Max 12 words.

btn-primary.text: CTA button text (e.g., 'Talk it through'). Max 3 words.

sec-head.h2: Tech stack heading (e.g., 'Tech stack & ecosystem'). Max 5 words.

stack-tabs.name: Category name (e.g., 'Orchestration & Frameworks', 'Vector Databases', 'Embedding Models', 'LLMs & Frontier Models', 'Evaluation & Deployment')

stack-panels.vec: Array of 4-6 vector database technologies (e.g., ['Pinecone', 'Weaviate', 'Qdrant', 'pgvector (PostgreSQL)', 'Chroma DB', 'FAISS'])
stack-panels.emb: Array of 4-6 embedding model providers (e.g., ['OpenAI Embeddings', 'Cohere Embed & Rerank', 'BAAI BGE', 'Voyage AI'])
stack-panels.llm: Array of 4-6 LLM models (e.g., ['OpenAI GPT-4o', 'Anthropic Claude', 'Google Gemini', 'Meta Llama 3', 'Mistral AI'])
stack-panels.eval: Array of 4-6 eval and deployment tools (e.g., ['RAGAS', 'DeepEval', 'FastAPI', 'Docker', 'AWS / GCP / Azure'])
